_comment: What the hosted Worker's privacy policy and terms (hosted_legal.js, /privacy and /terms) name that is not a catalog sentence: the date the text last changed, the operator's contact addresses (product owner, 2026-11-24), the periods set outside the Worker's own code, and the operator's commitments. `backup_days` is the R2 bucket's lifecycle rule, which docs/hosted-tenants.md §11.1 creates by hand, and `newsletter_hold_days` is UNMATCHED_HOLD_DAYS in src/cyris/adapters/fetch/newsletter_worker_source.py; tests/test_hosted_config.py holds both equal to their sources. `backup_removal_hours` is how long after expiry R2 says it usually removes an object (developers.cloudflare.com/r2/buckets/object-lifecycles, 'typically within 24 hours'), so the policy's longest stay of a deleted row in the backups is `backup_days` and that, in whole days, and `log_days` the Workers Logs retention of the Workers Paid plan, which the containers need (developers.cloudflare.com/workers/observability/logs/workers-logs): both are Cloudflare's, so a change of its documentation or of the plan changes them. `deletion_days` is the product owner's commitment (2026-11-24): a deletion request is done within that many days. `answer_days` are the periods of Article 13 of the Personal Data Protection Act, by request: `see` for an inquiry, a review or a copy (Article 10), `change` for completing, correcting, stopping or deleting (Article 11); each may be extended once by as many days again. The operator keeps every commitment by hand (docs/hosted-tenants.md, The privacy policy and terms). Change `updated` with any change to the pages' text.
